agent.name: Flag
agent.strategy: Bull flag: pole, quiet drift, breakout
agent.description: Well-formed bull flags: forming flags with trigger and stop, and breakouts on volume with a trade.

context.label: Well-formed
context.value: flag vol <= 70% of pole, pullback <= 40%, 5-8 sessions

setup.title: Flag
setup.label: 26% pole · 5-session flag · 28% pullback on 44% of pole volume

opportunities.reasoning: This flag shows decent structure—the pullback is tight and volume contracted appropriately. The setup dies if price closes below the flag bottom; it confirms only with a clean break above the trigger on volume that exceeds the pole's average. Forming flags statistically favor breakdowns, so skepticism is warranted until proven otherwise.
